title: US poison control calls for pediatric melatonin ingestion, 2012 vs 2021

source.name: Pediatric Melatonin Ingestions -- United States, 2012-2021 (MMWR)
source.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: National Poison Data System calls for pediatric (age <=19) melatonin ingestion rose from 8,337 in 2012 to 52,563 in 2021, a 530% increase over the decade, totaling 260,435 calls across the period.
